verdict.rationale: Kit documents a general integrations/App Store ecosystem, OAuth2 for third-party apps, and webhooks for real-time sync (kit-docs-15, kit-docs-22, kit-docs-21), which supports building connections to external stacks, but there is no evidence of maintained first-party integrations specifically for Stripe, Shopify, Segment, or a product database. missing for 10: named first-party connectors for Stripe/Shopify, a CDP like Segment, or database sync, and any case study/documentation confirming these specific integrations are maintained by Kit itself.
